leaderSection.title: House Republican leadership and Trump
leaderSection.note: Contributions from each leader's campaign committee, leadership PAC and joint fundraising committees, from the NRCC, and from President Trump's committees, from FEC filings. Committees are matched by FEC committee ID. Roles are from house.gov and the Clerk. Super PACs such as the Congressional Leadership Fund cannot give to candidates; their independent spending is not counted here. For Mike Johnson himself, transfers from his own joint fundraising committee (the Johnson Leadership Fund) are not listed as leader gifts, since the committee is his own.
